subject: general
question:
The pie chart shows the angular representation of placement data in five different courses. If the total number of candidates qualified is 1,44,000, then the number of candidates in Q is what percent of candidates in S? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de9ab99175124b04a3d71a334f8a8259801966751f867e2602ea422866f35614.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Value of 360° = 100%

So Q is (75/110) × 100 = 68.18 percent of candidates in S

**∴ The correct option is 3**
